pkgmetadata.longdescription: barrel_embed is an Erlang/Elixir library for generating text embeddings, supporting multiple providers including OpenAI, Cohere, Azure, AWS Bedrock, Mistral, Jina, Voyage, Vertex AI, as well as local models via sentence-transformers, fastembed, ColBERT, SPLADE, and CLIP through an embedded Python port server.
